senses.gloss:
रौहिक रौहिक = रुह इव, see Gaṇa
Aṅgulyādi to Pāṇ. V. 3, 108.

रौहिण रौहिण, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. रोहिणी), born
under the Nakṣatra Rohiṇī; (अस्), m. the sandal
tree; the Indian fig-tree; N. of Agni; of a demon
vanquished by Indra; a proper N. (according to
Naigh. I. 10) = मेघ, a cloud; N. of a gramma-
tical school; (अम्), n. sandal-wood; N. of the ninth
Muhūrta of the day; इन्द्रस्य राजन-रौहिणे
and धातू रौहिणम्, N. of particular Sāmans.
रौहिणक, अम्, n., N. of a Sāman.

रौहिणायन, अस्, m. (fr. रोहिण), a patronymic
of Priya-vrata.

रौहिणि, इस्, m. a patronymic; रौहिणेर् एकर्-
षे राजनम्, N. of a Sāman.

रौहिणेय, अस्, m. (fr. रोहिणी), a metronymic;
a calf, (also ई, f.); N. of Bala-rāma; the planet
Mercury; (अम्), n. an emerald.
—रौहिणेश्वर-
तीर्थ (˚ण-ईश्˚), अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha.

रौहित, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. रोहित), coming from the
animal or fish called रोहित; relating to Manu Ro-
hita; (अस्), m., N. of a son of Kṛṣṇa.

रौहितक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. रोहितक), Ved. made
from the wood of the Andersonia Rohitaka.

रौहीतक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. रोहीतक), coming
from the Andersonia Rohitaka, made of Andersonia
Rohitaka wood; coming from the district Rauhīta;
(अस्), m. = रोहीतक, Andesonia Rohitaka.

रौहिदश्व, अस्, m. (fr. रोहिद्-अश्व), a patro-
nymic of Vasu-manas.
रौहिष्, ट्, m. = रौहिष, a kind of deer.

रौहिष, अस्, m. (according to Uṇādi-s. I. 48.
fr. rt. 1. रुह्; cf. रोहित्, रोहित, रोहिष), a kind
of deer; a species of fish, = रोहित; (ई), f. a doe of
the Rauhiṣa species; a creeper (= लता); = दूर्वा;
a sort of grass (= कत्-तृण).
रौही, f. the female of a particular kind of deer.
रौहीत-देश, अस्, m., N. of a country.

रौहेय (fr. रोह), see Gaṇa Sakhyādi to Pāṇ.
IV. 2, 80.
